title: Spanish Prawn Paella
description: A classic Spanish dish from the Valencia region, made with succulent prawns, juicy saffron-infused rice, and a mediterranean twist.

ingredients.name: Mediterranean Vegetable Mix (200g)
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, zucchini, and cherry tomatoes

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large paella pan over medium heat.
Add paella seasoning mix and sauté for 1 minute.
Add Mediterranean vegetable mix and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Add prawns and cook for 2-3 minutes per side.
Stir in Jucy Spanish rice and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add 500ml of water and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 15-20 minutes or until the rice is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve with lemon wedges on the side.
